written_before: any full run; smokes may revise, revisions dated
format: prediction id: [statement, my probability]; bands coded in the scripts
aim: the program's own follow-ups to session 156: the crowd as suppressor tested by intervention (e697) and over training (e701); the sixteen-direction weak envelope as a linear function of the block input (e696); the ledger at 7B and 14B with the model in fp32 and the noise floor measured (e700)

e697_brake.question: does the sixteen-input simulation's damage come from off-class misfiring, and do sixteen inhibitory wires or the upstream weak-write bus restore the brake?
B0: every input reproduces the neuron (ratio under 0.05)
B1: the simulation swapped in only off the neuron's top-5% positions carries at least 0.7 of the all-position damage
B1b: swapped in only at the top-5% positions it carries at most 0.3
B2: the sixteen strongest excitatory with the sixteen strongest inhibitory inputs halve the sixteen-by-magnitude ratio at strong firings
B2b: and beat thirty-two by magnitude by 0.1
B3: the sixteen wires plus the crowd's write on the upstream weak-write bus halve the ratio
B4: signed wires plus the bus bring the ratio under 0.25
B5: the sixteen inhibitory wires carry at least half of the off-class net opposition
B6: the bus halves the all-position ratio

e696_bypass.question: is the weak write a linear function of the normalised block input, so a rank-16 bypass can replace the weak neurons at every block at once?
L1: the predicted sixteen coordinates recover at least 0.8 of what the oracle sixteen recover
L2: the predicted sixteen halve the zeroing cost
L3: the full linear prediction recovers at least 0.9 of what the oracle sixteen recover
L4: ARC-Easy accuracy under the predicted sixteen stays within 2 points of clean
L5: zeroing drops ARC-Easy by more than 5 points
L6: the linear map explains more than half of the weak write's variance on the fitting data

e701_brake_training.question: when does the brake form over Pythia-160m's training?
T1: at step 1000 the crowd's net sum off the class is within 0.3 of the sixteen wires' (no brake)
T2: the brake (under -0.5) is present by step 8000
T3: the brake strengthens monotonically with the step (Spearman under -0.8)
T4: the sixteen wires' net share at the core rises with training (Spearman above 0.5)
T5: the brake is under -0.5 in the final model

e700_ledger_fp32.question: with the model in fp32, activations stored in fp32 and the noise floor measured, does the K-input simulation become scorable at 7B and 14B?
N1: driven by every input the neuron is reproduced (ratio under 0.05) at 7B
N2: the noise floor (the neuron replaced by its own activation) is under 0.1 of the ablation damage for the selected neurons
N3: at 14B the sixteen-input ratio at strong firings is above 0.5
runs: qwen7b block 14 (32 windows), qwen14b block 24 (16 windows); no floor, 20 neurons selected by ablation KL among 100
e700_ledger_fp32.note: the bf16 attempt (e694) and a bf16 rerun with fp32 activation storage both left the all-inputs reproduction at 0.86 to 0.95 of the ablation damage: the residual stream itself is rounded to bf16 block by block, so the exact split can only be checked with the model in fp32
